atlas.loading.note: Loading message while the map loads; the interface adds an ellipsis

atlas.kicker.note: Small heading above the map title. Natural Earth (a basemap) and OpenBible (a coordinates dataset) are proper names

atlas.title.note: Page title: the map of the region where the story takes place ('theatre' as in theatre of operations)

atlas.confidence_title.note: Tooltip on a place marker: how sure the coordinates are. {pct} is a percentage like '85%', {source} the dataset that gave the coordinates

atlas.token_stop.note: While a journey plays on the map: the traveller's name and which stop of how many, e.g. 'Elijah · stop 2/5'

atlas.credits.text: Basemap: Natural Earth (public domain) · coordinates: OpenBible.info CC BY
atlas.credits.note: Attribution line under the map. Keep the proper names Natural Earth and OpenBible.info and the licence name CC BY

atlas.journeys.note: Panel title: the routes people travel in the story

atlas.stops.note: Number of stops on a journey

atlas.play_route.note: Button that animates a person's journey on the map; {name} is the traveller

atlas.place.note: Panel title for the place selected on the map

atlas.position.note: Label for a place's latitude and longitude

atlas.source.note: Label for the dataset the coordinates come from

atlas.confidence.note: Label for how sure the identification of a place's location is

atlas.confidence_unknown.note: Shown instead of a percentage when a place's confidence is not known

atlas.events_here.note: Small heading over the list of events that happen at the selected place

atlas.open_dossier.note: Link to the place's dossier page (its profile); an arrow follows it

atlas.places.note: Panel title: the list of places on the map

atlas.events_short.note: Number of events at a place, abbreviated to fit a narrow column ('ev' = events)
